selection: Fixed-seed nine-year x four-quarter day sample, up to two cases per acreage bin then fill to ten per day; outcome-complete cohort only.
scope: A paired weather diagnostic, not a population-weighted national error estimate; these data do not replace the original models' features.
same_source: Both use ERA5/Open-Meteo with GMT days and the same daily definitions. Near-fire coordinates select local ERA5 cells; still approximately25km reanalysis, not observed local fireground weather.
caveats: Only36 discovery days; clustered and size-enriched sample.
Requested elevations differ by location; this diagnostic measures the complete centroid proxy difference, not pure horizontal distance alone.
Calendar-day alignment to unknown source timezones remains approximate.
Existing fitted models still use the25-centroid features; applying point values to those models without retraining is not justified.
